settings.hero_subtitle: Gold Coast-based company dedicated to providing innovative dental solutions
settings.story_paragraph_1: Founded in 2017 by Angelo Di Franco, 3 Delta Dental was relaunched in 2023 with partner Emilio Ragazzo. Our leadership team brings over 37 years of combined technical expertise in the dental industry.
settings.story_paragraph_2: We serve as official distributors for prominent European dental brands including Micro Medica, Micropolymer, Vertsystem, Megadental Italia, Unidesa, Techim Group, Bausch, Mesa, and SDI.
settings.story_paragraph_3: Our inventory encompasses nano acrylics, fiber quartz, zirconia, metal alloys, and monolithic composite materials—all TGA approved.
